editorial:
Imagine being a regular person who is totally obsessed with magic, even though you have zero talent for it. That is exactly where you find Akko, a high-energy girl who just wants to be as amazing as her idol, Shiny Chariot. When she finally gets into the Little Witch Academy, she finds out that being a witch is way harder than it looks in the shows. You will love how the movie captures that feeling of being the underdog. The vibe is super bright and hopeful, making you feel like you are right there in the classroom with Akko and her new friends as they mess up spells and cause total chaos.

The animation is what really pops here, with colors that jump off the screen and action scenes that move quickly. While the plot is pretty simple and predictable, the heart and humor make up for it. It is a perfect pick for a cozy night in with the family.
endingExplained: After a lot of struggle, Akko proves that believing in yourself is more important than raw talent. She uses her determination to save the day and helps restore the magic of the school. The story wraps up with Akko and her friends becoming closer than ever. You see her finally gain some respect from her peers, proving that even a clumsy student can do great things if they never give up on their dreams.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves magic schools and underdog stories.
